_comment: Human-confirmed real variant labels from actual AliExpress per-SKU photos, used when property_value_definition_name is missing/unreliable and the German machine-translated value is itself wrong (see src/listing_quality/labels.py docstring). Keyed by product_id -> {sku_id: {aspect_name: real_value}}. Only overrides the exact sku_id listed; never invents a SKU. Every value here was confirmed by viewing the real AliExpress sku_image photo, not guessed.

1005005704381272._photo_note: English property_value_definition_name is the reliable source here (Blue/Green/Pink match their real photos); the German sku_property_value is cross-scrambled (Blue->schwarz, Green->Rot, Pink->Blau - all wrong). The 3 'white-ish' SKUs (3pcs/Elfenbein, Premium White/hellgelb, None/WEISS) all photograph as plain white and correctly collapse to one Weiss variant.

_blocked_needs_code_change._note: These 3 products have NO real colour axis at all - every SKU photographs identically; the true distinguishing attribute (pack quantity or size/grid-count) is mislabelled under AliExpress's own 'Farbe' property name. verified_variant_labels only overrides VALUES under the existing aspect name, it cannot rename the aspect axis itself (Farbe -> Menge/Groesse) - that needs a code change in variants.py/publish.py to add a 'rename_aspect' override, plus checking the chosen eBay category actually offers a variation-enabled Menge/Groesse aspect. Forcing a single fake colour value here would silently COLLAPSE real, differently-priced SKUs into one (duplicate-combo dedupe keeps only the cheapest) - never do that. Left correctly blocked for manual_review.
